changelog: `src/lib/fraud/offlineFraudRules.ts` (452 lines) splits two ways: the serialisable ruleset - types, the string patterns that go into the Android asset and the curated 12-rule list - moves to `ruleset.ts`, and the compiled matching engine (precompiled regexes, tie-breaking, the instant verdict, the safe-action finder and the asset serialiser) to `engine.ts`, with `index.ts` re-exporting the same public API. Import path unchanged, so no caller changed, including the Android asset exporter. Previous release: the AI fallback's engines, types, scoring and self-consistency sampler split into an `aiFallback/` folder.
